component.name: Aura
component.summary: Create procedural wallpapers and seamless monitor layouts

description.p: Aura is a native wallpaper studio with seven procedural effects, editable palettes and a live preview. Create wallpapers for desktops, phones and multi-monitor arrangements, save editable designs, and export 8-bit or 16-bit PNGs at their full resolution.
Aura works offline and requires no account.
Added Depot packaging and fixed settings schema availability in Flatpak menus.
